snippet.title: 10th Anniversary 🎉 | Pokémon GO
snippet.description:
Join in the celebration with a huge range of returning Pokémon that have previously appeared in Pokémon Go. Plus, there's a 2 day Pokémon Go tour event starting tomorrow!

Find all your favorite Pokémon merchandise at the official Pokémon Center: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/
Official Site: https://www.pokemon.com
Instagram: http://www.instagram.com/pokemon
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@pokemonofficial
